titleEn: Count Array Pairs Divisible by K
title: 统计可以被 K 整除的下标对数目
summary: 统计 i<j 且 nums[i]*nums[j] 能被 k 整除的数对数量。
insight: 一个数对 k 的有效信息只有 gcd(nums[i],k)。遍历当前公约数 g，与所有先前公约数 h 配对；当 g*h 能被 k 整除时，所有对应先前元素都贡献答案。
pitfalls: 枚举的是 k 的公约数种类
先计入答案再增加当前频次

solutions.title: 最大公约数频次配对
solutions.idea: 压缩每个数相对 k 的质因数覆盖情况。
steps: 遍历已有 (h,count)，若 g*h%k==0 则 answer+=count；最后 frequency[g]++

code.java: class Solution { private int gcd(int a,int b){while(b!=0){int temporary=a%b;a=b;b=temporary;}return a;}public long countPairs(int[] nums,int k){Map<Integer,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();long answer=0;for(int value:nums){int current=gcd(value,k);for(Map.Entry<Integer,Integer> entry:frequency.entrySet())if((long)current*entry.getKey()%k==0)answer+=entry.getValue();frequency.merge(current,1,Integer::sum);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun gcd(first:Int,second:Int):Int{var a=first;var b=second;while(b!=0){val temporary=a%b;a=b;b=temporary};return a};fun countPairs(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Long{val frequency=HashMap<Int,Int>();var answer=0L;for(value in nums){val current=gcd(value,k);for((other,count) in frequency)if(current.toLong()*other%k==0L)answer+=count;frequency[current]=(frequency[current]?:0)+1};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int gcd(int a,int b){while(b){int temporary=a%b;a=b;b=temporary;}return a;}public:long long countPairs(vector<int>& nums,int k){unordered_map<int,int> frequency;long long answer=0;for(int value:nums){int current=gcd(value,k);for(auto [other,count]:frequency)if((long long)current*other%k==0)answer+=count;++frequency[current];}return answer;} };
